baseline_observations: index-START.html lacks the :root CSS variable definitions (--base, --spacing, --blur) and variable bindings on img.
No cleanup or idempotent lifecycle management existed; re-attaching event listeners to inputs across re-initializations leads to duplicate listener invocation.
There was no exposed teardown/cleanup interface to unbind listeners or verify zero leftover test-created listeners.
decision: Add the CSS variable definitions and bindings to index-START.html. Implement an idempotent initCSSVariables() and cleanupCSSVariables() lifecycle using AbortController { signal } so repeated initializations never duplicate listeners, and cleanup leaves zero active listeners.
